sections.text_helper: Section 57.4.26 "Timer synchronization (TIM15 only)" in chapter 57 (General purpose timers (TIM15/TIM16/TIM17)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2867.
sections.section_content:
The TIMx timers are linked together internally for timer synchronization or chaining. Refer to
Section54.4.23: Timer synchronization for details.
Note: The clock of the slave peripherals (such as timer and ADC) receiving the tim_trgo signal
must be enabled prior to receive events from the master timer, and the clock frequency
(prescaler) must not be changed on-the-fly while triggers are received from the master
timer.
